rule: Freshness and provenance gates (F*, P*, and the integrity gates on the documents themselves) block the whole rebuild. A row-scoped failure withholds its own row and is published with the reason; it does not block the rest. An advisory gate never blocks and is always published: it records what a later official read showed, so the page can never imply it holds the newest filing when it does not.
